system.description: Mysterious folk touched by shadow, whether through curse, bloodline, or exposure to the Shadow Realm. Often misunderstood, they make excellent spies, scouts, and emissaries.
traits: Shadow Touched: You have advantage on Stealth checks in dim light or darkness.
Shadow Step: As a bonus action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is in dim light or darkness. Once per short rest.
Chilling Presence: When you hit a creature with an attack, you can reduce its speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Once per short rest.
